scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install-backend.ps1 && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install-desktop.ps1
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,desktop --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.app: concurrently --names backend,desktop --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run app:backend" "npm run app:desktop"
scripts.qa: npm run test:backend && npm run build:desktop && npm run app:check && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/qa-test.ps1
scripts.package:desktop: npm run package:backend && npm --prefix apps/desktop run package
